description: Na₆U₅V₂O₂₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.47-2.74 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent UO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one UO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 58-61°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.75 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ square pyramids that share corners with two UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids, and corners with two equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.73 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.71 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted body-centered cubic geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.88 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.97 Å. There are five inequivalent U sites. In the first U site, U is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-2.68 Å. In the second U site, U is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, corners with three equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one UO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 54°. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.37 Å. In the third U site, U is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.56 Å. In the fourth U site, U is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₅ square pyramid, corners with three equivalent VO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one UO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.38 Å. In the fifth U site, U is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted UO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and edges with two UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 58-61°. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-2.27 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids and corners with two equivalent NaO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.69-1.80 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to four O atoms to form VO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.67-1.78 Å. There are twenty-three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three U atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one U atom to form distorted ONa₃U tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one ONaU₃ trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one ONa₃U tetrahedra, and edges with two ONaU₃ trigonal pyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two U atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one U, and one V atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one U atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and three U atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two Na and one U atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one V atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two U and one V atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three U atoms to form ONaU₃ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃U tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONaU₃ trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃U tetrahedra. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two U, and one V atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two U, and one V atom. In the seventeenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one V atom. In the eighteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two U, and one V atom. In the nineteenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one U and one V atom. In the twentieth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three U atoms to form ONaU₃ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONaU₃ trigonal pyramid and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃U tetrahedra. In the twenty-first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one U atom. In the twenty-second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one U atom. In the twenty-third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one U atom.
